default.description: Fictional ADULT documentary guide Margot,30, not a real victim or historical portrait. Dusty blue ankle-length gown with wide bell cuffs, long brown belt tail, white linen veil, dark shoes. Ivory round head, dot eyes, tiny neutral mouth, no hair or nose. Dignified and fully clothed.

Fictional ADULT documentary Clerk,45, not a historical portrait. Olive cote and olive soft cap, brown hood collar, long brown belt tail, dark hose and brown shoes. Ivory circular head, tiny dot eyes and mouth, no hair, beard, nose or ears.
Fictional ADULT documentary Judge,55, not a historical portrait. Burgundy long robe and dark soft cap, dark shoes. Ivory circular dot-eye head, tiny mouth, no beard, nose or hair.
Fictional ADULT documentary companion Agnes,45. Ochre ankle-length gown, white linen veil, narrow brown belt tail, dark shoes. Ivory circular head, dot eyes and tiny mouth, no hair or nose.
